answer: In a decentralized AI economy, the Voting Power Index (VPI) mechanism can resist fake-identity attacks by assigning voting weights based on an agent's contribution to the network. This is akin to a quill assigning varying line widths to different strokes, where agents with more significant contributions receive greater voting power. By attending the summit of the network's knowledge graph, agents can demonstrate their expertise and earn more substantial voting plume, rendering it costly for attackers to create multiple fake identities.
